title: Arvell Reese, David Bailey, Rueben Bain have visited Titans

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Arvell Reese, David Bailey, Rueben Bain have visited Titans
sources.description: The Titans have been discussed as a potential landing spot for running back Jeremiyah Love with the fourth overall pick, but they have also spent time with three of the top defensive players in this year's class.
